page.title: Google Drive Backup Destinations
page.subtitle: Back up containers to a Google Drive location. The plugin handles OAuth consent, resumable upload (so backups of any size are supported), Download, Delete, and List at backup time via the Drive API v3.
page.registerHint: Install the storage-google-drive plugin from the App Store, then add a destination from the host's Storage Locations page and pick "Google Drive" as the type.

fields.refreshToken: Refresh token (delivered by the OAuth consent flow)
fields.folderId: Drive folder ID (leave empty to use My Drive root)

help.clientId: From Google Cloud console → APIs & Services → Credentials. Create an OAuth client of type "Web application" with the redirect URI set to your McHarbor host's /api/storage-locations/oauth/callback.
help.clientSecret: From the same OAuth client. Stored encrypted at rest by the host's AES-256-GCM service.
help.refreshToken: After saving the destination, click "Save and connect" to complete the Google consent flow and store a long-lived refresh token.
help.folderId: Optional. The tail end of a Drive folder URL after /folders/. Leave empty to upload into My Drive root.

error.noRefreshToken: Refresh token is required. Run "Save and connect" first.

form.introBody: Save this location, then use Connect to grant account consent. McHarbor stores the returned refresh token encrypted.

clientId.label: OAuth Client ID
clientId.help: Application (client) ID from the Google Cloud console → APIs & Services → Credentials. The OAuth client must be of type "Web application" with the redirect URI set to your McHarbor host's /api/storage-locations/oauth/callback.

clientSecret.label: OAuth Client Secret
clientSecret.help: Client secret from the same OAuth client. Stored encrypted at rest by the host's AES-256-GCM service.

basePath.label: Drive Folder ID
basePath.help: Optional. ID of the Drive folder where backups should land. Leave blank to use the Drive root. From drive.google.com → open the folder → copy the ID from the URL after /folders/.

steps.enableApi: In the Google Cloud console, open APIs & Services → Library, search for Google Drive API, and enable it for your project.
steps.createClient: Open APIs & Services → Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID. Choose Web application as the application type and add your McHarbor host's /api/storage-locations/oauth/callback URL to the authorized redirect URIs.
steps.copyCredentials: Copy the OAuth client's Client ID and Client Secret into the form on the left.
steps.folderId: Optionally enter a Drive folder ID to pin uploads to a specific folder. Leave blank to use My Drive root.
steps.connect: Click Save and connect (or Connect on the storage card). Google will ask you to sign in with the account that owns the target Drive and grant the drive.file scope. McHarbor stores the returned refresh token encrypted and never shows it again.
steps.test: Click Test connection to round-trip a probe file in the resolved folder.
